title: Exact target phases by interval-matched differencing

claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, for n = ceil(log2 N), the variable-width interval-matched phase sieve in proof.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 on independent clean copies. On every branch, total charged work is O(2^((29/10) sqrt(n))) with an absolute constant. The full envelope has growth index exactly 1/2. This bound holds jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims.

For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, for n = ceil(log2 N), the variable-width interval-matched phase sieve in proof.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 on independent clean copies. On every branch, peak allocated classical bits is O(2^((43/20) sqrt(n))) with an absolute constant. The full envelope has growth index exactly 1/2. This bound holds jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims.

For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, for n = ceil(log2 N), the variable-width interval-matched phase sieve in proof.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 on independent clean copies. On every branch, peak allocated qubits is O(2^((43/20) sqrt(n))) with an absolute constant. The full envelope has growth index exactly 1/2. This bound holds jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims.

For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, for n = ceil(log2 N), the variable-width interval-matched phase sieve in proof.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 on independent clean copies. On every branch, total acquired samples, including discarded and failed rows, is O(2^((29/10) sqrt(n))) with an absolute constant. The full envelope has growth index exactly 1/2. This bound holds jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims.

For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, for n = ceil(log2 N), the variable-width interval-matched phase sieve in proof.md recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 on independent clean copies. The guaranteed fractional tolerance is epsilon(n)=0 among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires all obtained source copies to be fresh independent ideal DCP states for the same secret and modulus. All four resource guarantees hold jointly on every branch.
